venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 10/26 (MOD MKZ; entered by MKZ; posted 12:01am 10/27).** Net $728 vs $798 target (-9%). Food $178. venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 10/26 (MOD/Chef Kyler, Jane, Matthew, Joaquin, Al, Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 3:08am 10/27).** Net $5,239 vs $3,982 target (+32%). Food $907 (~18% of net), beverage $4,331. Comps $91.30 (1.7%). 128 guests (SevenRooms), $41 check avg. Similar GCA to Sunday via exuberant mid tops (~$60 GCA), a couple of duos going big and heavy food sales. Slow first hour, then packed consistently until a massive drop-off ~11pm; staggered reservation system smoothed flow. Vinitaly conference visitors, Rangers fans, two anniversaries and an engagement. 156 oysters, 5 solos, zero large parties. Top sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, High Plains Drifter (tied). Kitchen: oysters diabolically shaped. Menu count 16. Breakage: 1 sidecar. No no-shows.
